description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
## Download at your own risk. Moku has made the change from Suwayomi to Tsunagu.
Official Release will come soon, this is simply a preview-beta version. Moku supports, LNReader Extensions, Manga Extensions, and Aniyomi Extensions (You are welcome to test more and report in the Discord).

Good Luck!

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.10.4...v0.10.5
